_why: The ONE postal address every email footer prints (CAN-SPAM 15 U.S.C. 7704(a)(5) needs a valid physical postal address). PHP reads it through alt_mail_postal_address(), Python through railway/postal_address.py. Change it here only. This is the Postadres Nederland postal mailbox, the public business postal address (owner ruling 2026-11-13, asktherecruiter-sandbox docs/DECISIONS.md), not a home or visiting address.
